page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced ecs.c7nex instance family running on a KVM hypervisor. It features 16 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, supported by 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The system is provisioned with 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 2 GB per vCPU allocation. Its CPU architecture incorporates 48 KB L1d cache per core, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, along with hardware support for instruction sets including AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and FMA. No local ephemeral storage is bundled with this instance type, requiring external disk volume attachment.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance consistently within the middle 50% performance bracket across compute, memory, and network tasks. Multi-core processor throughput reaches a score of 15531.0 in stress-ng and 9288.0 in Geekbench multi-core testing, while single-core performance registers 1885.18 and 1521.0 respectively. Memory subsystem throughput achieves 846.07 GB/sec for cached 16 KB read blocks, 99.38 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads, and 56.5 GB/sec for large block writes. In application benchmarks, static web serving reaches 20.56 GB/sec throughput, while Redis SET operations register 15.7 million operations per second.

The resource configuration offers a high vCPU-to-memory density suited for compute-bound tasks that do not require extensive memory footprints. The 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth complements high-throughput web serving and clustered execution. Tradeoffs include the complete lack of bundled local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU acceleration, necessitating reliance on network-attached cloud storage for persistent data. This resource balance provides a cost-effective platform for compute-focused execution, software compilation, data compression, and web tier serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the Enhanced family powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 32.0 GB of memory, it delivers a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio suited for CPU-heavy applications. The processor supports advanced instructions such as AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA-NI, alongside a 48 MB L3 cache. Across synthetic and application benchmarks—including Geekbench, PassMark, and stress-ng—the instance maintains baseline performance within the middle 50% threshold. It achieves 20.56 GB/sec in static web serving throughput and 15.7 million Redis SET operations per second. Supported by 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, it features no local storage or dedicated GPUs. This instance is well matched for software compilation, web serving, compressed data processing, and general compute-bound enterprise workloads.
